correctness.rationale: Over Q(i) and Q(sqrt(5)) the actual thirteen dual line-coefficient points from the source equations yield exactly 16 double, 6 triple, 4 quadruple and 2 quintuple intersections in each arrangement. The complete colored incidence graph of lines and all multiplicity-at-least-three points reconstructs the full lattice, since every remaining line-pair intersection is double; exact graph-isomorphism enumeration independently gives 2 and 8 lattice permutations with respective element-order profiles (1,1) and (1,5,2 for orders 1,2,4). For every lattice permutation a unique candidate dual projectivity is determined by a four-point projective frame, and testing all thirteen images leaves respectively 1 and 4 maps. These are C2 and D8 in the lattices, trivial and V4 in the projective stabilizers. The finite enumeration is exhaustive through the lattice-permutation upper bound, not merely a random sample.
residual_risks: The classification is only over C for the exact two explicit arrangements; no theorem about all realizations of either matroid or all weak-combinatorics realizations.
